name: mcp-free-cachyos
description: ChatGPT-native computer control and three-lane development orchestration for a private CachyOS MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Let ChatGPT operate and develop directly on CachyOS
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT remains the sole reasoning model while the private MCP provides controlled local tools, up to three concurrent logical inspection lanes, bounded patch application, independent verification, and tamper-evident receipts.

Complete this development task yourself through the native orchestration flow, preserve existing work, verify the outcome, and include every execution receipt.
